note: Example documents and questions for the Shannon QA demo. Questions were written for this demo (not taken from any exam). 'expect' is the answer the author had in mind, or null if the text does not answer the question.

docs.title: UN Charter (Articles 1-32)
docs.source: Charter of the United Nations, Articles 1-32 (Chapters I-V). Public text.

questions.q: How many members does the Security Council consist of?
Which countries are permanent members of the Security Council?
questions.expect: Republic of China, France, USSR, United Kingdom, United States

questions.q: For how long are the non-permanent members of the Security Council elected?
How many votes does each member of the General Assembly have?
Is membership of the United Nations open to all peace-loving states?
Which body recommends the admission of new Members?
What majority does the General Assembly need for decisions on important questions?
questions.expect: two-thirds majority of the members present and voting

questions.q: May the General Assembly make a recommendation on a dispute while the Security Council is dealing with it?
Who bears the expenses of the Organization?
questions.expect: the Members, as apportioned by the General Assembly

questions.q: Where is the headquarters of the United Nations?
What is the annual budget of the United Nations?
Who appoints the Secretary-General?

docs.title: US Constitution (Articles I-VII)
docs.source: The Constitution of the United States, preamble and Articles I-VII, from the National Archives transcription. Public domain.

questions.q: How old must a person be to be a Representative?
How long is the term of a Senator?
Who is the President of the Senate?
Who has the sole power of impeachment?
How many Senators does each State have?
Can a person who is thirty years old be elected President?
Who is Commander in Chief of the Army and Navy?
How many States had to ratify the Constitution for it to be established?
Who appoints ambassadors?
questions.expect: the President, with the advice and consent of the Senate

questions.q: In which court is the judicial power of the United States vested?
questions.expect: one supreme Court and inferior courts

questions.q: What is the yearly salary of the President in dollars?
How many electors does California have?
